title: Self-Pay Visit Package Pricing — Combining a Continuation Discount
content:
**Clause — combining discounts where a continuation discount applies (Self-Pay Visit Package bought again in the same tier).** Where a continuation discount applies and the purchase is a prompt renewal, the renewal, member and continuation discounts are added together; where a continuation discount applies otherwise, it is added to the higher of the renewal and member discounts. Where no continuation discount applies, this clause does not affect the combination.

**Prompt renewal, as used in this clause.** A purchase made no later than half of the tier's renewal window after the previous package of the tier was exhausted, where no visit of the exhausted package was forfeited. Half the window is 15 calendar days for the tiers with a 30-day window (Recovery 6-Visit, Core 8-Visit, Complete 12-Visit and Comprehensive 24-Visit Packages) and 0 days — the exhaustion date itself — for the tiers with a 0-day window (Starter 4-Visit and Post-Surgical 18-Visit Packages).

**Combination truth table**

| Continuation discount applies | Prompt renewal | Total discount |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | renewal, member and continuation discounts added together |
| Yes | No | continuation discount added to the higher of the renewal and member discounts |
| No | either | not affected by this clause |

**Hypothetical figures**

- Prompt renewal at 10 percent, member discount 8 percent, continuation discount 12 percent: 10, 8 and 12 added together give 30 percent.
- Not a prompt renewal, renewal discount 5 percent, member discount 8 percent, continuation discount 6 percent: the higher of 5 and 8 is 8, and 8 with 6 added gives 14 percent.
